name: softbody-drive
description: A BeamNG.drive-inspired soft-body car physics sandbox (WebGL2 + custom soft-body solver) built around the Tesla Model S model in this repo.

scripts.test: node tests/physics_test.mjs && node tests/damage_test.mjs && node tests/hud_test.mjs && node tests/skinning_test.mjs && node tests/node_texture_test.mjs && node tests/shader_contract_test.mjs && node tests/render_texture_test.mjs && node tests/gl_state_test.mjs && node tests/render_smoke.mjs
scripts.crash: SCENARIO=crash IMPACT=100 CRASH_T=2.4 CAM_DIST=5.2 CAM_YAW=2.3 CAM_PITCH=0.1 node tools/mirror_capture.mjs /tmp/crash && .venv/bin/python tools/mirror_shade.py /tmp/crash /tmp/crash.png
